title: Botomy
description:
Botomy is a strategy game where players program their bot to compete against others in an online arena. Precision and planning are everything. Decide, in real time, which items are worth collecting or how to battle against different enemies. 

 The game uses a simple client/server architecture to pass game state information to your code. Your code responds with a list of moves to be executed by your character. Edit and execute your code in real-time.

Use the built in editor for Javascript, or spin up your own controller server in any language/framework (typescript and python templates are provided).

Game modes:

Free For All Mode – Compete in different maps to optimize your bot’s decisions and logic. Highest XP wins the match.

Survival Mode – Battle against endless waves of enemies. Work together with other players to outsmart, outlast, and out-code.

NEW Training Room - Set up custom scenarios to test and refine your code. Hone your combat algorithms. Perfect your movement around obstacles. Optimize your collection strategy.

Basic Moves:

Attack

Shield

Move

Combine moves

Items

Big Potions - Healing

Rings - Cloaking

Speed Zappers

Special power ups

Bomb

Shockwave

Freeze

Features:

• Power Ups– Equip special attacks like Freeze, Bomb, and Shockwave

• Kill Streaks – Your character will overclock Speed, Attack, and Health with each killstreak achieved; culminating in a Super Mode

• Skill Trees – Customize your play style by choosing which upgrades to spend your skill points on: Speed, Health, or Attack

• Global Leaderboards – Track your progress and rise through the ranks

• Practice Offline – Test your bot before going live

• Choose Your Language – Program in your preferred coding language or use the built in Javascript editor

Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned coder, Botomy is a challenging new way to apply your programming skills. The best strategy wins.

Can your bot reach level 30?

Dev Environment Info: The built in language support is javascript but you can spin up your own custom local development environments in any language.
description_short: Botomy is a challenging strategy game where players program their character to compete in online multiplayer battles. Use the built in Javascript editor or run your own controller in any language/framework you like. Can your bot reach level 30?
